text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, some time after the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: AD
text_block_list.text: "BNW heading in! Thanks for having us!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. The three of us are 
quite new to this, but we look forward to 
working with you.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! It's so spacious! So pretty! And 
so much fuuun!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ticket, you're being loud.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"BNW was selected to appear in a 
commercial for an automaker, and they had 
arrived on set for the filming."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see. So the general concept for the 
commercial is our race scenes overlapping 
with cars in three colors.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There are also shots of everyone having 
fun riding in a car, and scenes where they 
say a phrase together...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: This looks like it'll take quite a while.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. To make sure everything goes 
smoothly, we must make thorough 
preparations...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Conquering the fastest"... "Conquering 
the fastest"... ...Maybe it should sound a 
bit more powerful?

text_block_list.name: AD
text_block_list.text: Well then, please start moving along now~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uwoooooh! I-It's getting all itchy~!! 
Wait-wait-wait, can I go run it off!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good, I'll join you. A light jog is 
a great way to relieve stress.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I told you it's almost time. ...Calm down, 
both of you.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Even if you tell me that—!! Why are you so 
calm about this, Taishin?!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Why, you ask...? ...No particular reason—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: It's no different from usual anyway.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"It hasn't changed at all?! I-It's 
completely different from the Academy 
though?!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That's not it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you guys are gonna be there, I 
guess nothin' much will change...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez, you're so noisy. Come on, let's 
go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the commercial shoot wrapped up 
without a hitch... The refreshing dynamic 
between the three friendly rivals went on 
to earn great acclaim.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Compared to before the race, that is.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That might be true, but still~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Shall we practice once? I feel like I'm 
definitely going to stumble over my 
words..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "Conquering the Fastest"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "Run forth, into tomorrow!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "I will not... yield victory."

text_block_list.name: BNW
text_block_list.text: 『Brand New World』

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oooooh! Done, done, done!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not quite satisfied with that...! 
Please, let me try one more time!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, footage of BNW training their 
hardest on their own was captured clearly 
in the making-of video.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Compared to before the race, that is.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I mean, that might be true, but still!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Shall we practice once? I feel like I'm 
definitely going to stumble over my 
words..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, perhaps thanks to the practice, 
the indoor shoot went smoothly, and we 
moved on to the outdoor shoot.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Phew...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All I gotta do here is race with 
everything I've got, right!

text_block_list.name: AD
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Just like those thrilling races 
you showed us in the Twinkle Series, 
please give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! Of course!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The course is Turf 2,500m, clockwise. I 
see, just like the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Then all the more reason not to lose. 
Especially to Taishin."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Totally!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ... Hmph, a rematch, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well, I have no intention of losing 
either. Even during photo shoots.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...To you guys.

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: All right then, get ready—!

text_block_list.name: BNW
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As multiple cameras tracked their 
movement— the three dashed across the turf 
with all their might, as if recreating the 
fervor of that day.
